text:
mira: Heads-up: PM asked for a narrowed callable API for Q2 that is easy to audit and migrate to. Need to pick the minimal envelope we can ship safely.
jamal: Agree on minimal. Proposal: v1 = synchronous JSON envelope + manifest validation. Keep async/webhooks and streaming for later.
kevin: Security note: any webhook or callback requires outbound auth and enterprise legal review. For v1, require response signatures whenever execution leaves our trust boundary.
olivia: Observability ask: every call needs a trace_id and token counts. Also include an optional confidence score when the model authored the tool output so evals can filter low-quality results.
sam: From product: customers want typed inputs/outputs, predictable errors, and a clear upgrade path. If we can accept optional webhooks in a v1.1, that will please larger customers.
jamal: Draft v1 envelope (compact):
```json
{
  "envelope_version": "1",
  "call_id": "1995087654-0",
  "tool_name": "string",
  "input": { "type": "object" },
  "result": {
    "status": "ok|error",
    "output": null,
    "error_code": null,
    "meta": { "duration_ms": 0 }
  },
  "telemetry": { "trace_id": "t-xyz", "tokens": 0 },
  "signature": null
}
```
kevin: Field notes: use `envelope_version` (explicit) over Accept header. Use `tool_name` (avoids ambiguity). Require `content_type` when `output` is binary or non-JSON. Signature required for cross-domain execution.
mira: Error taxonomy suggestion: `validation`, `execution`, `rate_limit`, `auth`. Keep codes machine-friendly (e.g., `validation.missing_field`).
jamal: Implementation plan: ship server-side JSON Schema enforcement, contract-tests suite, and SDK shims that map older client calls to new envelope. Keep schema backward-compatible by adding optional fields only.
olivia: Telemetry: add per-call token counts, start/end timestamps, and optional per-chunk offsets for future streaming. Ensure trace_id surfaces in logging and dashboards.
sam: Roadmap draft: Q2 GA = v1 (sync + manifests + docs), Q3 = v1.1 (opt-in webhooks + per-route rate limits), Q4 = v2 (streaming partial outputs + chunk signing).
deploy-bot: Canary policy: 14-day canary after deploy; contract tests must be green in staging.
jamal: Launch checklist (eng): public schema + examples, server validation, contract tests green, 2 partner canaries, SDK examples (JS/Py), telemetry dashboards + alerts.
kevin: Compliance items: document firewall requirements for webhooks, provide a pull-adapter option for private installs, and define KMS usage for signatures.
mira: Customer prioritization: enterprise customers with revenue commitments get webhook priority; PLG users keep the simple sync path.
jamal: Open decisions for Friday: 1) exact error strings and codes, 2) max payload size and content_type policy, 3) whether to allow optional `webhook_url` in v1 manifests (if present, require enterprise review).
kevin: I'll draft a security checklist and signature flow by Wed.
olivia: I'll produce telemetry key list and retention recommendations.
mira: Action items: jamal -> PR schema + contract tests by Thu, kevin -> security checklist, olivia -> telemetry spec, sam -> partner canary list. Reconvene Friday for sign-off. :thumbsup:
